title: Housing Crash Fears: Slower Sales, Higher Prices
description:
Jeremiah Babe predicts a housing crash, but a forecast is not a guaranteed outcome. This video follows his inflation warnings and calls for aggressive Federal Reserve hikes, bullish gold and silver outlook, Iran-related oil concerns, bearish 2027 stock forecast, and warnings about housing and adjustable-rate mortgages. Supplied September–October 2026 figures provide context on inflation, mortgage rates, home sales and prices. We also distinguish Kroger’s reported three-year job-cut plan from completed layoffs. The takeaway: financial anxiety is understandable, but stress-testing payments and preserving emergency savings beats panic-driven bets.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#Jeremiahbabe #Jeremiahbabehousingcrash #housingcrashprediction #MentalHealth #Wellness

music_mood: light rhythmic instrumental groove, warm keys, crisp soft percussion, curious and approachable, steady moderate energy, no ominous tension, no sirens or trailer impacts
hook: Jeremiah Babe predicts a housing crash—but that is his forecast, not a certainty.
reporter_prompt: Horizontal medium shot of a middle-aged American male reporter wearing a gray henley, standing on a public sidewalk beside an American residential subdivision with actual homes and a for-sale sign clearly visible behind him. Soft afternoon daylight, calm and approachable delivery, no dramatic gestures. This is an illustrative housing location, not Jeremiah Babe's location; do not impersonate him. Add graphics in postproduction only: charcoal panels, orange emphasis, bold condensed white letterin
